camel_example: aliyun live UpdateLiveCenterTransfer --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName teststream --DomainName 'example.com' --TransferArgs always --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DstUrl 'rtmp://push.example2.aliyunlive.com/testapp1/teststream2' --AppName testapp
description_en: Updates the live center transfer configuration by calling UpdateLiveCenterTransfer
description_zh: 调用UpdateLiveCenterTransfer修改直播中心转推配置
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-center-transfer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name testapp --stream-name teststream --dst-url rtmp://push.example2.aliyunlive.com/testapp1/teststream2 --transfer-args always --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLiveCenterTransfer

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream application. The AppName you enter must match the AppName of the live stream to be transferred for the configuration to take effect. You can view the AppName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流应用名称。输入的AppName必须与需要转推的直播流AppName保持一致，方可生效。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The third-party live streaming address to transfer to. A maximum of one address is supported.

The protocol of the destination address must match the protocol of the live stream being transferred. Only RTMP and SRT protocols are supported
parameters.help_zh:
转推的第三方直播地址，最多支持添加1个地址。

目标地址协议必须和转推的直播流协议一致，目前仅支持RTMP和SRT协议的转推地址
parameters.name: dst_url

parameters.help_en:
The transfer validity period. Valid values:

always: Permanently effective.

time: Effective within a specified time range.

If you set this parameter to time, StartTime and EndTime are required
parameters.help_zh:
转推有效时间。取值：

always：永久生效。

time：指定时间内有效。

取值为time时，StartTime和EndTime必填
parameters.name: transfer_args

parameters.help_en: The start time of the transfer. The date format follows ISO 8601 and uses UTC+0 time in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
转推开始时间。
日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the transfer. The date format follows ISO 8601 and uses UTC+0 time in the format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
转推结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time
